answer: Resist sybils by making influence grow only from an identity's own labor: every agent starts at the reputation nadir and holds one non-transferable kernel sealed to its earned work-history. Trust is an orchard where weight accrues like fruit, tree by tree, from verified tasks done for peers who did not pick you. A clone fleet each starts at nadir with an empty kernel, so flooding N fakes costs N full seasons of real labor; nothing grafts for free.
